caption:
PART 1/2 — The night an empty tanker hit New Orleans twice. 🚢⚠️

2 Feb 2016: the 817-ft Aframax tanker Nordbay, in ballast, heads down the Mississippi in high water with a strong current behind her and wind on her beam. At Nine-Mile Point she can't make the turn — and strikes a barge dock and the city's water intakes. And the night isn't over…

Part 2 tomorrow. Follow so you don't miss it.

Source: NTSB Marine Accident Brief MAB-17/30 (public report). Animated illustration, not a reconstruction.

#marineaccident #shipping #tanker #mississippiriver #neworleans #seafarer #merchantnavy #marineengineering #NTSB #maritime #shipping_news #jaimarineshorts

scenes.narration: Imagine you're on the bridge of this empty tanker. It's ten at night. The river is racing behind you... and she will not turn in time.
Twenty-two twelve. The engine revs suddenly drop. A strange vibration runs through the hull. One minute later, the bridge alarms go off.

scenes.headline: Meet the [Nordbay].
scenes.sub: 817-ft Aframax tanker · in ballast · 24 on board
scenes.narration: Earlier that evening, a river pilot boards the tanker Nordbay at a refinery dock. She is an Aframax, eight hundred and seventeen feet long. Tonight, she carries no cargo. Only ballast.

scenes.headline: An empty ship is a [giant sail].
scenes.narration: Empty, she floats high. Her deck stands about forty-four feet above the water, more than her draft below. With a southerly wind of up to twenty-four knots, that high hull becomes a giant sail.

scenes.headline: The river is [running high].
scenes.narration: The river is running high, after two months of high water. Its current, four to five knots, is pushing her from behind.

scenes.headline: [22:05] Huey P. Long Bridge.
scenes.narration: Twenty-two oh five. She passes under the Huey P. Long Bridge at almost fifteen knots over the ground. Just ahead lies Nine-Mile Point, a turn of about one hundred and thirty-five degrees to starboard.

scenes.headline: The pilot wants [more power].
scenes.narration: The pilot asks, do we have any more R P M? The master gives more. Then more again.

scenes.headline: Turning... but [sliding wide].
scenes.sub: Under 600 ft from the left bank
scenes.narration: She is turning fast. But the current is carrying her wide, closer and closer to the left bank. Twenty-two ten. The pilot calls for the danger signal.

scenes.headline: [22:13] First allision.
scenes.sub: Allision = a moving ship hits a fixed object
scenes.narration: Twenty-two thirteen. Nordbay slams into a barge dock, its mooring dolphins, and the city's water intakes.

scenes.headline: The hull is [breached].

items: Ballast tank No. 6 holed above the waterline

scenes.narration: Ballast tank number six is holed above the waterline. Ballast water sprays out. The general alarm sounds, and the crew musters.

lines: 53 minutes later, she hit New Orleans [again].

scenes.narration: Anyone would think the worst was over. It wasn't. Fifty-three minutes later, Nordbay would hit New Orleans again. Part two, tomorrow. Follow, so you don't miss it.

cover_title: EMPTY TANKER HITS NEW ORLEANS TWICE
